findings.title: Delete menu item is never shown in the alert list view
findings.body: The Delete item is rendered only under `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the list view the component is now called with `promRule` and no `rulerRule` (the ruler API is no longer queried), so the item is hidden even when `grafanaDeleteAllowed` is true. Users who can delete a Grafana rule from the list lose that action. The new permission logic computes `canDelete` from the Prometheus abilities, but the render condition still depends on the ruler rule. The same gating also applies to the Pause item at line 123 (`rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`), so Pause is also hidden in the list view.

findings.title: Silence menu item appears in list view but its action does nothing there
findings.body: `canSilence` is now true from the Prometheus-based abilities, so the 'Silence notifications' item is shown in the list view. Clicking it calls `handleSilence`, which sets `showSilenceDrawer` in RuleActionsButtons.V2. That drawer only renders when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds (RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx line 104), and `rule` (the ruler rule) is undefined in the list view. The user gets a menu item that silently does nothing.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in a list map without a key
findings.body: The previous code passed `key={key}` to the Grafana rule loader. The replacement `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` has no key, although it is rendered inside `rules.map(...)`. React will warn about missing keys, and reconciliation can reuse the wrong DOM nodes or component state when the list is paginated or reordered. The `key` computed by `getRuleKey` is still available in the destructuring on line 152.

findings.title: Federated rule group check was removed, so federated rules are treated as editable
findings.body: In `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` the check `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` was replaced by a hard-coded `const isFederated = false;` in `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`. This is a behavior change for Mimir data source rule groups that have `source_tenants`. Those rules were previously marked immutable and their Update/Delete/Duplicate/Pause actions were disabled. They now become available. The TODO does not justify removing a working check from a path that is still in use. `isFederatedRuleGroup` is only passed a group, and the hook now receives only the rule.

findings.title: View link no longer carries the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The removed `GrafanaRuleLoader` built the view href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem` drops `returnTo`, so navigating from the list to the rule view and back no longer restores the list position or filters. Other rule list items in this repo keep this behavior.

findings.title: Test asserts the buggy 4-item menu, so the missing Delete action goes unnoticed
findings.body: This is the list-view test for AlertRuleMenu. The test in GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx asserts that the menu has exactly 4 items (line 207). The user is granted AlertingRuleDelete and the `delete` menuitem selector is defined (line 42) but never used. The test therefore locks in the absence of Delete (and Pause) in the list view. Nothing checks that Silence actually opens a drawer.
